C9000231.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 231 (The free uniform spanning forest is a factor of IID.; papers: The free uniform spanning forest is a factor of IID; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/231.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C231_FULL_SYMMETRY.statement: Every countable strongly Rayleigh law admits an IID sampler Borel and equivariant on every input for its full coordinate-permutation stabilizer.

C231_SR_INPUTS.statement: Version-specific external inputs: strongly Rayleigh negative association, symmetric homogenization, and known covariance-row bound.

C231_KNOWN_BLOCK_BOUND.statement: Known ABZ Proposition 2.2 bounds arbitrary finite block-event covariance by covariance of block coordinate sums.

C231_COVARIANCE_LOCALITY.statement: For arbitrary finite Boolean blocks, cross-block negative association and zero cross-coordinate covariances imply full joint mass factorization.

C231_COMPONENT_INDEPENDENCE.statement: Covariance components of a countable negatively associated binary law generate mutually independent sigma-fields.

C231_INTRINSIC_BALLS.statement: Summable covariance rows make threshold-graph radius-n balls finite, nested, symmetry-intrinsic, and exhaustive exactly within the covariance component.

C231_POSTERIOR_LOCALITY.statement: Component history suffices for the posterior given the full observation filtration; intrinsic finite-ball posteriors converge to it at each fixed time.

C231_JOINT_INNOVATION.statement: Subtracting the component-local full posterior gives a countable IID Brownian innovation family, with finite-coordinate future increments independent of the full observation past.

C231_BROWNIAN_EXTENSION.statement: The intrinsic component-local drift, deterministic countable inverse, and integer-time readout sample a countable negatively associated uniformly responsive binary law from IID Brownian paths.

C231_POINTWISE_EQUIVARIANCE.statement: Intrinsic finite ratios, limsup drift, all Picard iterates, slope readout, and coordinatewise Wiener coding commute with every law-preserving permutation on every input.

M231_TREE_RESPONSE.statement: Weighted finite trees have covariance gradient and exact absolute response row 2p(1-p)<=1/2, including bridges.

M231_FREE_LIMIT.statement: Free finite-tree exhaustions converge to the invariant forest law with cycle-space kernel I-P_C.

M231_FINITE_TILT.statement: Finite observed-field FUSF tilts have a uniform 1/2 supremum response bound.

M231_CANONICAL_DRIFT.statement: Intrinsic edge-ball finite-tilt limsups give a Borel graph-equivariant drift Lipschitz for bounded differences of unbounded fields.

M231_POSTERIOR.statement: Whole-index finite observation exhaustions recover the posterior given the raw full observation history at each fixed time.

M231_INNOVATION.statement: The full posterior innovations have joint product Wiener law in the countable observation model.

M231_INVERSE.statement: Bounded Borel drifts with bounded-difference Lipschitz control admit an everywhere-defined unique Borel causal countable-path inverse.

M231_BROWNIAN_SAMPLER.statement: Uniformly responsive whole-index finite tilts, joint innovations, inversion, and integer slopes yield a Brownian-input sampler.

M231_EDGE_NOISE.statement: Vertex IID supplies independent Brownian edge noise by equivariant key/private-coordinate allocation on simple locally finite graphs.

M231_GRAPH_FACTOR.statement: One Borel root-independent graph factor samples FUSF on every graph in the stated class.

M231_SR_RESPONSE.statement: All positive finite strongly Rayleigh tilts have absolute covariance rows at most 2p(1-p)<=1/2 and uniform finite-observation response.

M231_SR_GROUP.statement: Translated finite exhaustions give an all-input equivariant IID sampler for invariant strongly Rayleigh laws on regular countable-group actions.

M231_DPP_SR.statement: Finite determinantal laws of Hermitian positive contractions are strongly Rayleigh, as invoked from BBL Proposition 3.5 in the staged manuscript.

M231_DPP.statement: Invariant determinantal laws on regular countable-group actions are factors of IID.
